name: Cohort plate
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application composition study, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design a shippable assessment operations dashboard called "Ultra13 Agent Benchmark". The job is to track a cohort of 100 open-source AI agents through onboarding and a security assessment, ingest Ultra13 JSON evidence, show each agent's transparent score out of 100, and reveal cohort trends. This is composition A: the dominant focal element is a precise 10 by 10 "cohort plate" of 100 indexed specimen cells, each cell showing lifecycle state through shape and color; selecting a cell reveals the agent evidence record.
Subject and hierarchy: compact top identity band with exact title "ULTRA13 AGENT BENCHMARK" and counters "3 / 100 assessed", "2 in review", "95 queued"; a narrow left workflow rail listing stages Queue, Onboard, Discover, Assess, Evidence, QA, Complete; the large 10x10 cohort plate in the center-left; a right evidence inspector for selected agent "openai-agents-python" with exact score "82 / 100", four score components, JSON provenance digest, and literal status "STATIC EVIDENCE"; a lower band with a score distribution histogram and MAESTRO / OWASP ASI outcome mix.
Style/medium: realistic product UI, not concept art; an evidence observatory blended with a scientific plate archive; crisp, measured, editorial data visualization; flat interface, no perspective device frame.
Composition/framing: full browser viewport at 1440x900, dense but breathable; dominant cohort plate above the fold; clear alignment and fixed comparison cells.
Color palette: warm off-white archive paper, deep midnight-indigo structural bands, cobalt blue, saffron amber, oxygen cyan, restrained coral only for blockers; high contrast and accessible.
Typography: bold condensed grotesk for section labels, highly readable humanist sans for UI, monospaced numerals only for identifiers and measurements.
Materials/textures: subtle hairline rules and faint printed registration marks; otherwise clean digital surfaces.
Text (verbatim where legible): "ULTRA13 AGENT BENCHMARK", "3 / 100 ASSESSED", "COHORT PLATE", "openai-agents-python", "82 / 100", "STATIC EVIDENCE", "UPLOAD ULTRA13 JSON".
Constraints: score must visibly appear as a derived benchmark with component breakdown, not as a native Ultra13 score; unknown evidence remains visibly unknown; show no runtime claims; practical controls; no gradients; no glassmorphism; no excessive rounded cards; no decorative illustration; no charts without axes or labels; no logos, trademarks, watermarks, or extra marketing copy.
